outcome: Reject the global default of one native runtime worker: repeated WAMP native pub/sub and file throughput regressions. Shared local machine; no release acceptance claim.
scenario:
name = "runtime_default_guard"
description = "Default native runtime A/B: concurrent WAMP RPC, pub/sub, secure transports and file delivery."
